problem: N.E.K.O queues both newly dispatched commissions and commissions being taken up again. The commission/session rows are durable, but requeue primary text, queued secondary notes, copy hand-back notes, and wake-note ordering otherwise depend on TaskAgentManager memory. A host death must reconstruct only the current queue epoch without flattening _Handed/_Unsaid/_Found provenance, duplicating native wake delivery, drifting session identity, or reviving cancellation.

authority_boundary.continuation: N.E.K.O Ledger events in the existing ledger; restart_queue_resume/restart_queue_note are thin envelopes, never a second queue
authority_boundary.effect: N.E.K.O host_calls + existing managed idempotency/receipt semantics
authority_boundary.wake: N.E.K.O native wake_requests/session hand-over remains text/delivery authority; durable queue envelopes store wake identity/order only

reuse_search.L0_authority: Keep commission/session/queue authority in N.E.K.O; persist only the otherwise-volatile take-up text in the existing event log.

reusable: TaskAgentManager._start_next starts queued work using _resume when present
L1_neko_current_pin.gap: _requeue transitions to queued before writing continuation only to in-memory _resume; Ledger._reconcile then fails every old queued commission.

L2_neko_upstream_extensions.result: Latest upstream NekoPower still keeps _queue/_resume/_notes in TaskAgentManager memory and Ledger._reconcile explicitly marks prior-host queued/working/waiting_user commissions failed. No recover_restart equivalent exists. The four commits after a0bb do not touch any of the 19 migration-patch target files.

reuse_search.L3_native_adjacent: Use existing task-agent queue/start/session lookup only; do not add a scheduler.
reuse_search.L4_external: External workflow engines/reliable queues are rejected because they would duplicate the frozen commission/session authority.
reuse_search.L5_thin_integration: Selected candidate: append durable resume/note envelopes into the existing Ledger before acknowledging queue state, preserve prior-host task-agent queued rows, reconstruct only the current queue epoch through native _know_session/_queue/_start_next, and re-hand wake text through native session wake authority.

safety_rules: Durable primary continuation and pre-resume notes commit before transition to queued; failed/orphan attempts cannot become a later queue epoch.

Acknowledged queued user text is recovered from the native told event; internal secondary notes use only the existing Ledger event stream, and each accepted note/provenance item is appended exactly once.
Recovery considers only current task_agent queued commissions; terminal/cancelled rows are never revived and cancellation is rechecked after session resolution.
Initial queued commissions keep native opening semantics; a requeue without a durable current-epoch continuation fails closed before any effect.
Requeued commissions reuse their durable native session identity; initial queued work may receive only the same canonical first session native code would assign.
Serialized _Handed text is never replayed as authority. Timer and cross-session message wakes are verified by native session wake ids and re-handed once.
A wake that was the primary continuation is restored as primary _resume; secondary wake notes keep queue-note order and receive text from native hand-over.
No prior-host working commission is recovered by this unit; working/effect ambiguity remains blocked/unknown under the separate active-working candidate.
No host_call status grants permission or authorizes replay; effects remain governed by current permission, idempotency, unknown-effect, outbox and receipt semantics.
promotion: CANDIDATE_ONLY_AFTER_FULL_GREEN: restart continuity is a dependent multi-patch stack and the managed core budget is already 14/14; do not promote by count expansion or patch bundling. Prefer migration to latest NekoPower and retire/rebase old patches with equivalent acceptance.
retirement_condition: Delete when upstream N.E.K.O durably reconstructs initial/requeued task-agent queues, ordered queued notes and native wake provenance after host restart without replaying active effects or restoring stale authority.
